safety: aggregate/schema only; no paths, identifiers, hashes, or clinical text emitted; source files unmodified
correction_verdict: CORRECTED: a reliable composite study key exists

path_parse.note: study_folder label is NOT globally unique (restarts within each patient), so it must be combined with the patient component

partition_identity.note: deid_patient_id maps 1:1 to the patient folder; split is fully determined by patient. All three candidates are the same partition. cand1 (patient_folder + study_folder) is the recommended definition (self-contained in the path, no dependence on split labels).

official_comparison.conclusion: observed study count matches the officially documented total exactly (not forced)

within_study_report_consistency_normaliz.method: sha1 over whitespace-collapsed, lowercased, stripped section text; distinct non-null hashes per study

report_near_unique_reexamination.root_cause: previous 'near-unique report per image' was a field-choice + grouping misinterpretation, NOT a normalization bug: the FULL report field is genuinely captured per-image (varies in ~all multi-image studies), but the label-source sections (impression/findings) are ~97% duplicated across a study's images. The prior audit read full-report variance as 'no study structure', which was wrong.

multi_image_study_section_divergence.note: a real minority of multi-image studies pair genuinely different section text; documented caveat, does not invalidate the key (count matches official; 0 multi-patient/multi-split)

hierarchy_confirmed.report_sections_duplicated_across_study_: largely yes (impression 97.1%, clinical_history 99.3%); full raw report field is per-image and not duplicated

frontal_structure.note: 37 lateral-only studies; 3,356 studies (1.8%) carry >1 frontal image; image-selection policy deferred

rules: CheXbert impression labels at BOTH MIMIC and CheXpert Plus
CheXbert findings labels at BOTH MIMIC and CheXpert Plus
do NOT mix MIMIC CheXpert-labeler outputs with CheXpert Plus CheXbert outputs in the primary experiment

recommendations.study_key: use derived composite study key: patient_folder + study_folder
recommendations.evaluation_clustering_unit: study-level clustering (report sections shared within study; account for intra-study correlation)
recommendations.config_layout: separate proposed configs: chexpert_plus_impression.yaml (primary) and chexpert_plus_findings.yaml (sensitivity)
